items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'you played at Tom Anderson's', but the interviewee does not respond to confirm this or describe a personal relationship with Tom Anderson.

ctx.x: I quit the band in 1917. Well, when the show got here I think you quit. In 1917, that was?

The show got here and then you played at Tom Anderson's. Until you got your teeth fixed. Yeah, how did you play with your players? And when the circus come through here you and her grabbed the show and went back out on the coast because they used to win it in California. And that's how he went back out to California. And he went up, took a little bit of a round. What is Sacramento? That address you should have, some rare address. Was that Sacramento?
Yes, we had five pieces. Rush panel and spare horn.
